summary: On October 1, 2026, the 2026-2027 public oyster season opened for harvest of market-sized oysters. Effective October 19, 2026, Area I “B”, Area II “B”, Area II “E”, and Area V “A” reopened for commercial and recreational harvesting. All harvesting shall begin no earlier than legal sunrise and must cease prior to 12:00 PM.

no_harvest.lead: All Mississippi waters and public reef areas therein shall remain closed on Sundays and the following days:
days: Christmas closure: harvest shall cease and all vessels shall check out no later than 12:00 p.m. on Christmas Eve, Thursday, December 24, 2026. All waters shall remain closed through Sunday, December 27, 2026, and shall reopen at legal sunrise on Monday, December 28, 2026.

New Year closure: harvest shall cease and all vessels shall check out no later than 12:00 p.m. on New Year’s Eve, Thursday, December 31, 2026. All waters shall remain closed through Sunday, January 3, 2027, and shall reopen at legal sunrise on Monday, January 4, 2027.
